expectFullname: C08-G05 stamp-draft 选择移动与层 slot C08-G05-01 nextStampLayerSlotId 基名可用时返回 base
patch:
--- a/packages/editor/src/core/stamp-draft.ts
+++ b/packages/editor/src/core/stamp-draft.ts
@@ -91,7 +91,7 @@
 
 export function nextStampLayerSlotId(draft: StampTemplate, base = 'layer'): string {
   const used = new Set(draft.layers.map(({ id }) => id))
-  if (!used.has(base)) return base
+  if (!used.has(base)) return `${base}-x`
   let suffix = 2
   while (used.has(`${base}-${suffix}`)) suffix++
   return `${base}-${suffix}`
